# CortexFit - Intelligent Gym Management Software

CortexFit is a multi-tenant B2B2C SaaS platform designed for modern fitness businesses in Africa and globally.

## Core Capabilities
- Member Management and Access Control
- Subscription Billing and Payment Processing
- Custom Branded Gym Websites (Programmatic SEO)
- Trainer and Class Scheduling
- Automated Transactional Emails

## Target Audience
- Independent Gym Owners
- Health Clubs
- Fitness Franchises
- Boutique Studios

## Technical Architecture
- Built on Next.js App Router
- Multi-tenant PostgreSQL database
- Stripe for payments
- Magic Link authentication

## API and Integration
Currently, CortexFit operates as a closed ecosystem. Public API access for third-party integrations is on our long-term roadmap.

## Pricing
Pricing is capability-based, offering flexible tiers designed to scale with gym revenue.

## Support
For technical support, gym owners can contact support@cortexsystems.com.
